recommended_action: Immediately disable the unauthorized inbox forwarding rules across the affected mailboxes, force password resets for the compromised user accounts (amorel@contoso.com, tkowalski@contoso.com, lferreira@contoso.com), revoke their active sessions, and investigate the source IP address for broader credential access or session hijacking activity.
summary: An investigation into the alert regarding suspicious inbox forwarding rules confirmed that three separate user mailboxes (amorel@contoso.com, tkowalski@contoso.com, and lferreira@contoso.com) had inbox rules created within a 13-minute window by the same external IP address. These rules automatically forward emails containing financial and invoice-related keywords to an external domain address (ap.remittance@contoso-invoices.example). This activity exhibits characteristics of BEC / financial fraud collection, confirming the alert as a true positive.
